shortDescription: MEXICO CITY, Sept 22 (Reuters) - Mexican retail sales fell 0.1% in July from June, the national statistics agency said on Tuesday.Sales increased 1.8% in July compared to the same month a year earlier.((Mexico City newsroom, +52 55 5282-7153, mexicocity.newsroom@reuters.com))

children: MEXICO CITY, Sept 22 (Reuters) - Mexican retail sales fell 0.1% in July from June, the national statistics agency said on Tuesday.
